scope: changed artifacts only since creative QA v1

captionPath.detail: Episode-specific SceneRenderer no longer burns the continuous WordSyncedCaption layer. Existing authored scene labels remain as sparse editorial callouts. This addresses the v1 subtitle-led frame problem in source, but it cannot receive a publish-grade score until an actual V2 MP4/contact sheet exists.

visualBeatDensity.detail: Episode-specific SceneRenderer adds a deliberate second framing after 52% of each scene via a focal-origin scale jump, yielding roughly two framings per authored scene. This plausibly raises effective beat density from ~42 toward ~84, but pacing/continuity must be judged on the rendered MP4.

environmentVariety.detail: BrainSleepAtmosphere adds distinct bedroom, lab, office, ocean, night-sky, city and abstract environment overlays keyed to scene family. Opacity is restrained. Actual readability, compositing order and novelty still require render review.

soundDesign.detail: The soundtrack canary successfully generated a 531.425s deterministic copyright-safe bed with 24 sparse authored cues. Artifact probe found AAC, 24 kHz, mono; mean volume -23.1 dB and peak -0.9 dB. Because the intended bed/SFX are flattened to mono and the actual final video mix has not been rendered/listened to, soundDesign remains below publish-grade verification.

blockingFindings.finding: No V2 MP4/contact sheet exists. The current Episode 1 Render Canary only runs when state === VOICE_READY, while canonical state is QA_FAILED, so a failed episode cannot currently re-enter the render stage.

The current render workflow still executes npm run render:episode and does not invoke tools/render/render-episode-with-soundtrack.mjs, so even if the gate reopened, the new V2 soundtrack would not be included in the rendered canary.

The generated soundtrack artifact is AAC 24 kHz mono despite synthesized stereo ambience/SFX inputs. Before publish-grade approval, preserve an appropriate final mix format/channel layout and verify the actual rendered video's audio technically and perceptually.

requiredFixes: Add an explicit QA_FAILED -> factory revision/re-render path without weakening revision safety or publish gates.
Wire the V2 render canary to the soundtrack-aware render path and require the soundtrack canary artifact as an input.
Produce a fresh V2 MP4, contact sheet, render manifest and technical QA report; do not reuse v1 artifacts.
Ensure final mixed audio has an intentional channel/sample-rate policy suitable for upload, then rerun clipping/silence/loudness checks on the final MP4.
Return the fresh V2 render to independent creative QA for first-30s, visual variety, caption, sound, pacing and ending review.
